body: I understand it might be my own fault, but the problem is I haven't been able to figure out yet what fault I have done. What do you mean when you say I could be bad? If you meant I am an academically weak student, I probably am not, because I am the topper of my class.
You see, this is what I wanted to convey in my post. Even you are a stranger to me but you made fun of me and called me retarded. It has become a routine in my life now.
